title: The Gazette, one week
text:
Front page, copied.
Mon. Gauge steady. Reassuring.
Tue. Gauge steady. Reassuring.
Wed. Gauge steady. Most reassuring.
Thu. Gauge steady. Reassuring.
Fri. No reading. A recipe for marrow jam.
Sat. Gauge steady. Reassuring.
Mine, the same week, from the rim: up a hand's breadth.
"Most" is new. Watch for "most".
